sidekick-pulse.description: An array of several tips with vibrant illustrations come together. Abstract illustration suggests that admin data is being pulled together to form one specific suggestion regarding converting customers in the new year.

textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun50: New year momentum: convert, bundle, and scale
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun52: A/B test a free shipping threshold to lift average order value
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun53: Your discounted orders already outperform full-price, showing that customers respond to incentives. With a 65.2% margin, you could test a free shipping threshold to raise AOV, without a major hit to shipping costs. Consider A/B testing a $175 threshold for 2–4 weeks and adding cart messaging like "Add $X more for free shipping."
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun55: Set up abandoned cart emails to recover lost sales
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun56: Your store sees 257 shoppers reach checkout each month, but only about half finish their purchase, leaving many carts behind. Automating abandoned cart emails can help you win back these lost orders, with industry stats showing 10–20% of shopper return to complete their purchase when prompted. Setting up a follow-up email series is an effective way to turn missed opportunities into extra revenue each month.
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun58: Launch a new year campaign targeting your clothing bestsellers to boost seasonal revenue
textRunMap.pulseDesktop/rivePulseTextRun59: Hearthside Hoodies did $487k in organic sales in 90 days. Consider launching a 25% off "Hoodie Season" promo with 15% off hoodie + beanie bundles, gift card offers, segmented emails, and refreshed copy focused on gifting and winter layering.

sidekick-builds-workflows-in-shopify-flo.description: A sidekick prompt field asking to be emailed when any product inventory drops below 5. The flow is then created.

textRunMap.sidekick/riveFlowTextRun3: I'll create a workflow that monitors inventory levels and emails you when any product variant drops below 5 for the first time.
textRunMap.sidekick/riveFlowTextRun6: Monitors inventory changes for all product variants in your store
textRunMap.sidekick/riveFlowTextRun9: Checks if inventory drops below 5 for the first time (current inventory is less than 5 AND previous inventory was 5 or more)
textRunMap.sidekick/riveFlowTextRun12: Sends you an email with details including the product name, variant, current inventory level, previous inventory level, and SKU
textRunMap.flow/riveFlowTextRun14: This workflow starts when the inventory level changes for a specific product variant.
textRunMap.flow/riveFlowTextRun16: Product variant inventory quantity is less than 5.0
textRunMap.flow/riveFlowTextRun18: Inventory quantity prior is greater than or equal to 5.0
textRunMap.flow/riveFlowTextRun22: Send email to david@mvseskate.com with the following subject:
textRunMap.flowMain/riveFlowTextRun24: Create a workflow to email me when inventory for any variant drops below 5 for the first time

shopify-simgym-app.description: A simulation test is run by AI changing the hero on the page, and then feedback is shared.

textRunMap.riveSimGymTextRun1: The product categories overlap with the same item appearing in multiple places.
textRunMap.riveSimGymTextRun2: I found exactly what I was looking for within seconds using the search bar!
textRunMap.riveSimGymTextRun3: The Shop Pay button being so visible and easy to use was great.
textRunMap.riveSimGymTextRun4: Finding the "About us" page was difficult, consider making it easier to find.
textRunMap.riveSimGymTextRun5: The trust badges in checkout reassured me that my payment info is safe.
textRunMap.riveSimGymTextRun6: I loved seeing actual customer photos in the reviews section.
textRunMap.riveSimGymTextRun7: I couldn't find any information about the return policy, which made me hesitant.
textRunMap.riveSimGymTextRun8: Moving around the site was much easier than I expected!
textRunMap.riveSimGymTextRun9: I appreciate that the mobile menu doesn't require a lot of scrolling to find what I need.
textRunMap.riveSimGymTextRun10: The text was tiny so I had to zoom in, and then buttons were hard to press accurately.
